title: Vanishing Coalitional Influence of a Majority Head
statement: Let $k,m:\bbn\to\bbn$ be sequences of natural numbers. If $m(q)\to\infty$ and $k(q)/\sqrt{k(q)+m(q)}\to 0$ as $q\to\infty$, then the coalitional influence of the first $k(q)$ coordinates for the majority function on $k(q)+m(q)$ sign coordinates tends to zero as $q\to\infty$.
